# mtncloud_instance_deploy (Resource)

Deploys a version of a deployment to an instance, as the instance's Deploy tab does, and keeps it deployed: a new `version_id`, `config` or `triggers` deploys again in place (the deploy it replaces is kept as archived, for a rollback in the console). The apply waits for the deploy's run on the instance and fails with its message if it fails. When someone deploys another version of the same deployment, or a deploy's run fails, the plan deploys this one again. Deploys to one instance run one at a time. The instance's image must have a deploy folder: MTN's standard images don't yet, and deploying to them fails with "missing a deploy folder configuration". MTN Cloud can't undeploy, so destroying this leaves the files on the instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_instance_deploy" "web" {
  instance_id   = mtncloud_instance.web.id
  deployment_id = mtncloud_deployment.web.id
  version_id    = mtncloud_deployment_version.v2.id

  # Deploy again when the version's files change.
  triggers = {
    index = mtncloud_deployment_file.index.content_sha256
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_id` (String) The deployment, for example `mtncloud_deployment.web.id`.
- `instance_id` (String) The instance, for example `mtncloud_instance.web.id`.
- `version_id` (String) The version to deploy, for example `mtncloud_deployment_version.v2.id`. Changing it deploys that version in place.

### Optional

- `config` (Map of String) Settings for the deploy that depend on the instance's type. Changing them deploys again.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `triggers` (Map of String) Any values: changing one deploys the same version again, for example after its files change.

### Read-Only

- `deploy_id` (String) ID of the current deploy.
- `id` (String) `<instance_id>/<deployment_id>`.
- `run_id` (String) ID of the deploy's run in the instance's history (its History tab). Empty when no run was found.
- `status` (String) The deploy's status: `committed` when it is live, `failed` when it or its run failed.
- `version` (String) The deployed version's name.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The instance's ID, then / and the deployment's ID: its live deploy.
terraform import mtncloud_instance_deploy.web <instance_id>/<deployment_id>
```
